title: FU 2 graph edge desync root cause is missing edge removal events
summary: FU-2 .graph edge desync reproduced by inspection and regression: overlay.save emitted edge_added and edge_promoted into graph-store, but no event when overlay.removeEdge deleted an edge. Because edges are no longer stored in overlay JSON, a fresh overlay.load replayed the old edge_added from .graph and resurrected removed add_dependency/remove_dependency edges. Fix in this attempt adds edge_removed emission and graph-store replay, with overlay-split coverage proving removed edges stay absent after reload.
